paper_title: Organic Photovoltaics' New Renaissance: Advances Toward Roll-to-Roll Manufacturing of Non-Fullerene Acceptor Organic Photovoltaics
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Materials Technologies - 2022 - NG - Organic Photovoltaics  New Renaissance  Advances Toward Roll‐to‐Roll Manufacturing (1)/auto/Adv Materials Technologies - 2022 - NG - Organic Photovoltaics  New Renaissance  Advances Toward Roll‐to‐Roll Manufacturing (1).md

knowledge_points.content: Conventional fullerene-based organic photovoltaics (F-OPVs) face a theoretical power conversion efficiency (PCE) bottleneck of approximately 10%, whereas non-fullerene acceptor (NFA) based devices have achieved laboratory PCEs exceeding 18%.
knowledge_points.evidence: This has proven to be the main PCE bottleneck with an expected theoretical PCE of 10% for conventional fullerene-based OPVs (F-OPVs)... Since then, record NFA-OPV PCEs have risen rapidly and reached over 18%

knowledge_points.content: Fused-ring non-fullerene acceptors (NFAs) exhibit high exciton diffusion coefficients (over 10^-2 cm^2 s^-1) and long exciton diffusion lengths (approximately 30 nm or greater), significantly exceeding those of fullerene derivatives.
knowledge_points.evidence: They exhibit high exciton diffusion coefficients of over 10^-2 cm^2 s^-1, which often corresponds to high exciton diffusion lengths (≳ 30 nm).

knowledge_points.content: The donor polymer PM6 (a fluorinated derivative of PBDB-T) and the NFA Y6 (also known as BTP-4F) are highly complementary, with PM6 absorbing in the 400–650 nm range and Y6 absorbing in the 600–950 nm range.
knowledge_points.evidence: The benzothiadiazole core of Y6 allows it to pair well with PBDB-T-2F (PM6) which has a complementary light absorption range of 400–650 nm... Y6 has a broad light absorption range of 600–950 nm.

knowledge_points.content: In NFA-based OPVs, hole-transfer from the acceptor to the donor can become the dominant channel for photocurrent generation, supplementing the conventional electron-transfer channel used in fullerene-based devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: the complementary absorption of NFAs and polymer donors introduces hole-transfer photocurrent generation channels alongside conventional electron-transfer... hole transfer from the acceptor becomes the dominant channel of photocurrent generation.

knowledge_points.content: NFA thin films are more tolerant of coarse phase separation (morphology sizes around 50 nm) than fullerene-based films, allowing for more efficient charge separation even in larger domains and facilitating layer-by-layer processing.
knowledge_points.evidence: NFA blends can accommodate much coarser phase separation than their fullerene counterparts... these photophysical properties of NFAs account for the observed phase sizes on the order of 50 nm for optimized blends

knowledge_points.content: The 'scaling lag' in OPV performance refers to the efficiency drop when moving from small-scale lab devices to large-area modules, caused by factors like increased series resistance, lower conductivity of flexible PET substrates, and non-uniform film deposition.
knowledge_points.evidence: the difference in maximum PCE achieved from scaled-up demonstrations from current stat-of-the-art demonstrations has manifested itself as what is commonly described as the 'scaling lag.'... These substrates [PET] often have poorer transparency, electrode conductivity, smoothness and thermal robustness compared to glass.

knowledge_points.content: Spin-coating is an inefficient method for large-scale manufacturing because it is a batch process where 95–98% of the material dispensed is wasted during the spinning process.
knowledge_points.evidence: Paradoxically, even though only small amounts of material are required, only 2-5% of the material dispensed on the substrate tends to remain while 95-98% is flung off leading to high levels of wastage.

knowledge_points.content: Slot-die coating is preferred over blade coating for large-area industrial scale-up because it allows for the deposition of well-defined linear patterns, whereas blade coating is limited to 'flood-coating' the entire substrate.
knowledge_points.evidence: slot-die systems are able to produce well-defined linear patterns and as opposed to the 'flood-coating' limitations of blade coating, thereby making it a more suitable method for the fabrication of large-area NFA-OPV modules

knowledge_points.content: NFA-OPVs have demonstrated a projected operational lifetime of 10 to 20 years by utilizing the rigid fused-ring structure of NFAs and suppressing chemical reactions at the ZnO/active layer interface.
knowledge_points.evidence: A projected lifetime of 10 to 20 years have been demonstrated after suppressing chemical reactions between the ZnO and BHJ interface... The tunability of the molecular structures of NFAs... allows NFA devices to be adjusted for optimal stability.

knowledge_points.content: N2200 is a naphthalene diimide (NDI)-based polymer acceptor with a narrow bandgap (~1.5 eV) that is frequently used in ternary blends to optimize film morphology and balance charge transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: The most representative of these materials is N2200, a NDI-based small molecule... N2200 has a relatively narrow bandgap of ≈ 1.5 eV... the incorporation of N2200 into ternary mixtures produces optimized morphology and more balanced charge transport.

knowledge_points.content: The record power conversion efficiency for a roll-to-roll compatible (R2R-C) demonstration using a PM6:Y6 system is 16.35%, while the record for a large-area module (80 cm^2) is 5.25%.
knowledge_points.evidence: This PCE translates well into the realm of R2R scale-up with a record R2R-C demonstration PCE of 16.35% currently held by Sun et al... record size of 80.00 cm^2 achieved by Han et al. at 5.25% PCE.

knowledge_points.content: Fluorination or chlorination of the thiophene unit in the side chains of PBDB-T derivatives (resulting in polymers like PM6 and PM7) can increase device PCE from ~8% to over 13% by improving energy level alignment and aggregation behavior.
knowledge_points.evidence: Fluorination and chlorination of the thiophene unit of the benzodithiophene (BDT) side chains can lead to the much improved PBDB-T-2F (PM6) and PBDB-T-2Cl (PM7) and increased PCEs of > 13%
